item: H118: requesting alliance help on a running node shortens it
finding: PARTLY SUPPORTED, NOT MEASURED AT THE NODE LEVEL
evidence: the Help page (alliance-help/2240, 22:40Z) lists four of our requests, each 30/30: a Lv.29 Drill Ground (our Lv.28 ground upgrading), Food Output V, a Lv.27 Drill Ground (our Lv.26 ground), Oil Output I; the builders' panel drew no help indicator on any row (18:06Z, 23:52Z); no record holds one request on one node with the end time before and after
status: what is still untested: the per-help cut

finding: the Lv.27 and Lv.28 grounds both shrank 0.8600 and 0.8602; 0.995 to the 30th power is 0.8604 (30 helps at 0.5 percent of the remaining time each) AND 2.0 / 2.325 is 0.8602: two readings fit to four digits
evidence: the Lv.27 ground (our third ground) has no row among the four read (the fourth was cut off, no scroll): if it has no help request, an identical shrink on it argues for a common cause (the speed factor), not help; Lv.26 fell a further 165 minutes beyond the common factor and is the only candidate for a help effect

item: the +0.2 step in the construction speed factor (2.125 to 2.325 for new builds between 08:14Z and 17:33Z)
finding: NOT the alliance technology Quick Construction
evidence: Quick Construction has been Lv.9 of 10 in every donation record from 11-22 09:21Z to 11-25 01:40Z; its panel read 'Increased Building Speed for Allies, current +22.5% next +25%' on 11-23 at 10:04Z: a level is 2.5 points, a tenth of the step; the Tech EXP bar read 4.2M at 10:04Z on 11-23, 4.4M at 14:39Z and 5.1M at 17:51Z on 11-24 against 8.0M
status: the source of the step is unknown

finding: the Oil Well Lv.24 (ends 07:11:19.6Z, constant within 1 s at every read since 17:31Z, no help row among the four): REQUEST help on it, read its end time before, at +1, +10 and +30 minutes and the row's helps count: if 30 helps cut 0.5 percent of the remaining time each, the end falls about 14 percent of the 3.2 hours left, about 27 minutes
status: MY PRIORS: P(the end falls after the request) 0.70; P(the fall is 20 to 35 minutes if 30 helps arrive) 0.40; P(30 of 30 within 30 minutes) 0.60
